name: Creator Growth Empire
tagline: From $0 to a multi-million-dollar creator company.
notes: Self-describing manifest. Base is api/v1/ relative to the site root — works on any static host; no auth, no keys, no rate limits. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. The deployed site ships its own api/ mirror, so the explorer works live too.

endpoints.description: This manifest — self-describing list of every endpoint with schema URLs, updated timestamps, record counts, and deprecation notes. Start here.
All nine phases: id, phase label, title, site-relative path, word count, read minutes. Use headings to navigate before fetching full text from llms-full.txt or the chapter page.

The Niche Atlas dataset v2.0.0: 20 October-2026-researched niches — channel growth, search growth, breakout formats, creator-reported revenue ranges (CPM/RPM), competition, startup cost, skill fit, chapter/simulator/case-file links, the avoid list (red-flag niches, 2027-updated), sources, and the <1%-reach-100K reality check — plus the 2027 outlook layer: per-niche trajectory badges (heating/stable/cooling with basis + signals), breakout-format spotlights, platform signals, and the niche-to-revenue-stream fit matrix. Ranges, never promises.
endpoints.freshness_note: Research observed 2026-10-11; 2027 outlook layer added 2026-10-11 (trajectory badges are directional reads, not forecasts). Verify platform figures live before acting — every record carries its sources and observation date.

endpoints.description: Calculator config: per-niche long-form RPM bands, Shorts RPM, platform thresholds (YPP tiers, TikTok Rewards, Facebook CMP — with sources and dates), revenue splits, the 2026 sponsorship rate card, and 2026 niche/platform research snapshots. The data contract the sim engine, revenue calculator, deal analyzer, and hiring calculator read.
endpoints.records_note: Config snapshot, not a record list: 9 niche RPM bands, 2026 rate card, platform thresholds, revenue splits, research snapshots.
endpoints.freshness_note: Verify platform figures live before acting on them — see the payload's own updated/version fields. Treat undated numbers as stale.

endpoints.description: The Deal Room data contract: negotiation scripts (lowball counter, usage-rights upsell, exclusivity pushback, rush-fee ask — with {{placeholders}}), the red-flag checklist with severity levels and scoring rules, and usage-rights pricing tiers with reported vs. definitional multiplier basis, 3 honest pitch email templates (cold pitch, one follow-up nudge, warm intro — [bracketed] placeholders, never invented stats), and the 10-item contract red-flag checklist with scoring rules. A negotiation aid, not financial/legal/tax advice.
endpoints.records_note: Data contract, not a record list: 4 negotiation scripts, 6 red-flag items, 6 usage-rights tiers, 3 pitch email templates, 10 contract red-flag items.
endpoints.freshness_note: Multipliers are reported 2026 benchmarks and ranges, not quotes. Verify against current creator rate reports before quoting.

endpoints.description: The Content Engine data contract v1.1.0: idea formats, the five Short-Form Playbook hook structures, calendar dealing rules, batching guidance (consistency-beats-volume), the Repurposing 2.0 derivative map (each derivative's required original element), the Oct-1 originality guardrails, deal-slot guidance, the simulator bridge — plus the 2.0 additions: the Oct-2026 algorithm signal map (TikTok/Shorts/Reels, every claim source-labeled), 6 trend-derived hook patterns, the cross-post adaptation matrix (12 source→destination rule sets + universal checks), and the weekly batch scheduler defaults. A planning aid, not financial/legal/tax advice.
endpoints.records_note: Data contract, not a record list: 3 idea formats, 5 hook structures, 7 dealing rules, 7 repurposing-2.0 derivatives, 5 originality guardrails.
endpoints.freshness_note: Hook structures are craft formulas from the Short-Form Playbook, not platform documentation. Niche tags resolve against api/v1/niches.json.

endpoints.description: Skill index: name, description, repo-relative path for every executable skill. Full skill content lives in skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

Index of the documented creator-business deconstructions: id, badge, title, path, words, read_minutes. Full text on the case-*.html pages. Figures are source-reported, not audited — never present as promises.
All nineteen interactive tools with programmatic input schemas (JSON Schema draft-07), output descriptions, and drive notes — replicate the tools' logic without the UI.

Human-readable reference pages: the 2026 sponsorship rate card, the Niche Atlas, the Metrics Glossary, and the 2026 Platform Rules Bible. Machine-readable equivalents: rate card in calculators.json sponsorship_rate_card_2026; the atlas in niches.json; glossary terms in glossary.json.
